title: New Transmitter not connecting, Sensor Status stuck on 'Stopped', multiple queued items in Status page. Nothing is working... HELP!
symptom: After changing transmitter and sensor, the sensor status is stuck on 'Stopped' with a permanent notification, and multiple queued items appear in the status page. The new transmitter does not connect, and the app seems unresponsive despite resetting the phone and restarting the app.
fix: The thread suggests checking the transmitter ID is entered correctly, keeping the G6 status tab open to watch for scanning/connecting, and if it connects, stop and start the sensor. Another user suggests changing to specific settings (shown in a screenshot) and restarting the collector, waiting 5 minutes.
evidence_quote: Please double double check that you have the new transmitter id entered correctly. Keep the G6 status tab open and watch it for 5 minutes - does it proceed from scanning to connecting with the transmitter? If so then select stop sensor and then start sensor and try again.
